fields.name: button_pressed
fields.description: `no` at step #1 (nothing has happened yet). `yes` at every step from the one whose execution steps show the button pressed down (gripper descended onto the button) onward, i.e. from step #2 to the end of the episode. e.g. yes

fields.name: pending_cubes
fields.description: Ordered list of [y, x] positions of cubes that sit on highlighted white areas and have not yet been picked up. `[]` at step #1. At the step whose execution steps show the highlighted areas (the button-press step, #2), write one entry per highlighted area: the [y, x] of the cube whose position is nearest that area, in the order the highlighted areas are listed in the observation. At each later step, drop the entry of a cube that the execution steps show held in the gripper (picked up), so the list shrinks by one at each pick-up step and stays the same at the place step. e.g. [[89, 146], [63, 150]]
